#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Compiles the Kotlin sources into a self-contained jar and writes ./app,
# a launcher that runs it on the JVM.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

mkdir -p build
kotlinc src/Main.kt -include-runtime -d build/wordfreq.jar

cat > app <<'LAUNCHER'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
exec java -XX:+UseSerialGC -jar "$(dirname "$0")/build/wordfreq.jar" "$@"
LAUNCHER
chmod +x app
